description: Muinaiset rantaviivat Lounais-Suomessa is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Varsinais-Suomen liitto. Aineisto perustuu Maanmittauslaitoksen korkeusmalliin (pelastuskarttalehdet 19M, 19N, 20M ja 20N), joka on poimittu Paikkatietolainaamosta. Alkuperäinen malli on laskettu peruskartan korkeuskäyristä ja rantaviiva-elementeistä kolmioverkkointerpoloinnilla ruutumalliksi, jossa ruudun koko on 25 m x 25 m. Coverage: Varsinais-Suomen liitto. The publisher named on the listing is Varsinais-Suomen liitto. Its keywords include korkeus, Uusimaa, avoindata.fi, Rantaviiva, Varsinais-Suomi, rantaviiva. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ZIP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
